author_repository.basis: normal public Git HEAD read; not necessarily the exact paper-era code version

scope: Risk-neutral vs physical distributions/variance premia over2017-2022 and retrospective market-regime analysis; not a demonstrated net strategy.
version_separation: v1search summaries use downside concern;v2abstract says variance and upside concern in low-vol regime. Do not merge versions.
raw_inputs_required: Timestamped native option trades, full bid/ask/depth and size, contract identity/strike/expiry/settlement denomination
Underlying index AND actual hedge instrument quotes/funding/mark data, option/futures wallet currencies and cash FX
Applicable fee/minimum size/ticks/margin/settlement rules and original publication/revisions
Continuous chain/inventory marks and terminal settlement evidence, including missing/untradable intervals
paper_method: BVIX-like variance from option price surface and27day monthly horizon, not a directly traded DVOL position
Physical variance and density are sample-estimated; implied-minus-realized difference is not a cash PnL
RND CLR transform and full-pair Ward clustering are retrospective; any trading state classifier needs past-only fit/assignment
PaperUSDprice conversion, carry/interest assumptions and native inverse/BTC cash economics require local mapping
